description: Use this whenever the user asks about a specific public company or stock ticker in general: 'tell me about X stock', 'how is X doing', X's share price or chart, valuation (P/E, forward P/E), margins, revenue, growth, debt, dividend, how far it is from its 52-week high. Accepts a ticker or company name. Shows a compact interactive card: price, 1-year chart, 52-week range, key fundamentals grouped as Valuation / Quality / Growth / Health, and invest-like's four plain verdicts (profit, growth, price, debt). Covers 21,000+ stocks worldwide. For 'is X a good investment' or 'should I buy X', use analyze_stock instead.

stock.description: Ticker or company name, e.g. 'NKE' or 'Nike'

name: stock_overview
title: Stock overview with chart and fundamentals
